about: Legacy Godot attack cases (tabletop/vectors/legacy/attacks.json) moved to the 1-14 scale: every attacker and defender stat +5, weapon numbers from the prototype's standard.json written into each case. Expected values are the prototype's own, rounded to 2 decimals there, so damage figures are compared to within 0.006. Countermeasures and Systems were not part of these cases; 5 is filled in and the lock is given (locked or none).
